primary_endpoint: Change in liver stiffness on MRE at 6 or 12 months.
efficacy_outcome: MRE stiffness change (kPa): at 6 months, spironolactone 0.025 vs placebo −0.265; at 12 months, spironolactone 0.105 vs placebo 0.135. No statistical comparison reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 0/11 with spironolactone and 0/6 with placebo; no deaths in either group.
